results.name: Band Assisted Chin Up (From Knee)
instructions: Loop a resistance band around a pull-up bar and secure the other end under one knee while keeping the other leg straight.
Grip the pull-up bar with an underhand grip (palms facing back), hands shoulder-width apart.
Using the assistance of the band, pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
tips: Ensure the resistance band is securely in place under your knee to provide consistent assistance and avoid injury.
Avoid using momentum; focus on using your arm and back muscles to perform the pull-up.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you pull up and inhaling as you lower yourself down.
results.description: Band Assisted Chin Up (From Knee) is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Upper Back, Shoulders.

results.name: Band Bent-Over Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the resistance band under both feet, ensuring it is secure. Hold one handle of the band in each hand with your palms facing each other, bending your torso forward at the hips while keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Let your arms hang straight down toward the floor, fully extended, with your elbows slightly bent.
Pull the handles towards your torso by bending your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly lower the handles back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure the resistance band is securely placed under your feet to avoid slipping.
Exhale as you pull the band towards your torso and inhale as you lower it back down.
Perform the exercise slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement.
results.description: Band Bent-Over Row is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Shoulders.

results.name: Band Fixed Back Underhand Pulldown
instructions: Secure the middle of the resistance band to a sturdy anchor point over head height. Sit on a box or a bench under the anchor point, holding one handle of the band in each hand with an underhand grip (palms facing back), arms extended overhead.
Pull the handles down towards your shoulders, bending your elbows and keeping them close to your body until your hands are near your shoulders.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure the resistance band is securely anchored to avoid slipping.
Exhale as you pull the band down and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Use a resistance band with appropriate tension to ensure you can perform the exercise with good form.
results.description: Band Fixed Back Underhand Pulldown is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Biceps.

results.name: Band Kneeling Lat Pulldown
instructions: Secure the middle of the resistance band to a sturdy anchor point above head height. Kneel on the floor facing the anchor point, holding one handle of the band in each hand with your arms extended overhead and palms facing forward.
Pull the handles down towards your shoulders, bending your elbows and keeping them close to your body until your hands are near shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom of the movement, ensuring a full contraction of your back muscles.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you pull the band handles down and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Perform the exercise slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement.
Focus on squeezing your back muscles at the bottom of the movement.
results.description: Band Kneeling Lat Pulldown is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Biceps.

results.name: Band Kneeling Single Arm High Row
instructions: Attach a loop resistance band to a sturdy anchor point above head height. Kneel on your right knee, with the opposite foot flat on the ground for balance. Hold one end of the band with your right arm and keep it fully extended.
Pull the band down towards your torso by bending your elbow and squeezing your shoulder blade.
Slowly return to the starting position, extending your arm fully while maintaining control.
Repeat for the desired repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Use a controlled motion to pull and release the band, avoiding jerking movements.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you pull the band and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blade at the top of the movement to maximize back activation.
results.description: Band Kneeling Single Arm High Row is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Rear Shoulders, Biceps.

results.name: Band Lying Reverse Grip Row
instructions: Lie chest-first on an incline bench, with your feet firmly planted on the floor for stability. Hold the handles of a resistance band anchored below the bench with a reverse grip (palms forward) and allow them to hang down.
Pull the handles of the band upwards towards your torso by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body, and squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position, extending your arms back down towards the floor.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise to avoid straining your lower back.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you pull the band and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Keep your elbows close to your body to maximize back engagement and minimize shoulder involvement.
results.description: Band Lying Reverse Grip Row is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Biceps.

results.name: Band Pull Up
instructions: Securely loop a resistance band around a pull-up bar. Place one or both feet into the bottom of the loop band. Grip the pull-up bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, palms facing forward.
Start in a dead hang position with your arms fully extended.
Pull yourself upward by bending your elbows and driving them down towards your sides, bringing your chin above the bar.
Lower yourself back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you pull up and inhaling as you lower yourself.
Adjust the resistance band to match your strength level. Thicker bands provide more assistance.
Avoid using momentum; focus on pulling with your back and arms.
results.description: Band Pull Up is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Triceps.

results.name: Band Rotating Hammer Grip Incline Bench Row
instructions: Adjust an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and lie face down on the bench with your forefeet firmly on the floor. Place the resistance band under the bench and hold one handle of the band in each hand using an underhand grip (palms facing up), letting your arms hang straight down.
Pull the handles towards your torso by bending your elbows, rotating them to a hammer grip (palms facing you), and keeping them close to your body until your hands are near your sides.
Extend your arms back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Ensure the resistance band is securely placed under the bench to avoid slipping.
Exhale as you pull the band handles towards your torso and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Use a resistance band with appropriate tension to ensure you can perform the exercise with good form.
results.description: Band Rotating Hammer Grip Incline Bench Row is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Biceps.

results.name: Barbell Bent Over Row Pronate Grip
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with both hands in a pronated grip (palms facing backward), and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Slightly bend your knees, and hinge at your hips to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the floor. Keep your back straight and your gaze forward.
Pull the barbell towards your abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement. Keeping your elbows close to your body.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position with control, extending your arms fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid rounding your back by keeping your chest up and your spine neutral.
Move the barbell slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you pull the barbell up and inhaling as you lower it back down.
results.description: Barbell Bent Over Row Pronate Grip is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Forearms.
